title: Pure Lost World
summary: The Lost World Dinosaur strategy revolves around the titular Field Spell, spawning a Jurraegg Token to lock opponent targeting while enabling deck-destruction loops with Babycerasaurus to swarm the board and summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno.

summary.title: Starters & Searchers
points: Lost World: Signature Field Spell that reduces non-Dinosaur ATK/DEF by 500, summons a Jurraegg Token to the opponent's field to protect your monsters from targeting, and protects Normal Monsters by destroying a Dinosaur in your hand or Deck instead.
Souleating Oviraptor: Searches or sends any Dinosaur from Deck on summon, and targets the Jurraegg Token for destruction to trigger Lost World's Deck-pop protection while reviving a Dinosaur.
Fossil Dig and Terraforming: Spell searchers that ensure consistent Turn 1 access to Souleating Oviraptor and Lost World.

Miscellaneousaurus: Hand trap that renders all your Dinosaurs unaffected by opponent activated effects during the Main Phase, and banishes itself and GY Dinosaurs to summon Animadorned Archosaur or Babycerasaurus from Deck.

summary.title: Opening: Oviraptor and Lost World Loop
steps: Activate Lost World, then Normal Summon Souleating Oviraptor to trigger both Lost World (spawning a Jurraegg Token to the opponent's field) and Oviraptor (adding Babycerasaurus to hand).

Activate Oviraptor targeting the opponent's Jurraegg Token to destroy it and revive a Dinosaur; protect the Normal Monster Token using Lost World by destroying Babycerasaurus directly from your Deck instead.
Trigger Babycerasaurus in the GY to Special Summon Babycerasaurus or Miscellaneousaurus from your Deck.
Destroy the second Babycerasaurus with Animadorned Archosaur or Scrap Raptor, fetching Double Evolution Pill and summoning Giant Rex or Petiteranodon.
Overlay Level 4 Dinosaurs into Evolzar Laggia or Evolzar Dolkka, then activate Double Evolution Pill to summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoffs
points: Ultimate Conductor Tyranno: 3500 ATK Dinosaur boss that flips all opponent monsters face-down as a Quick Effect during either player's Main Phase, attacks every monster your opponent controls, and sends Defense Position monsters to the GY while burning for 1000 damage.
Evolzar Laggia: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz that detaches two materials to negate any Normal or Special Summon, or Spell/Trap card activation.
Evolzar Dolkka: Rank 4 Dragon Xyz that detaches one material without once-per-turn restriction to negate and destroy an opponent's monster effect.
Evolzar Lars: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz that detaches material to negate any face-up card on the field.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Double Evolution Pill: Banishes one Dinosaur and one non-Dinosaur from hand or GY to Special Summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from hand or Deck ignoring summoning conditions.

Survival's End: Normal Trap that destroys all Normal Monsters on field (including the Jurraegg Token) to Special Summon Dinosaurs from Deck, and banishes from GY to destroy one Dinosaur you control and one opponent card.
Pentestag: Link-2 monster co-linked with Ultimate Conductor Tyranno to grant it piercing battle damage against face-down Defense Position monsters.

allow.Megalosmasher X: Level 4 WATER Dinosaur Normal Monster (2000 ATK) that triggers Survival's End on the field to destroy Normal Monsters and summon Dinosaurs from your Deck.
allow.Scrap Raptor: Level 4 EARTH Dinosaur Tuner that destroys itself or Babycerasaurus on the field (or protects the Jurraegg Token via Lost World to pop Babycerasaurus from Deck!) and grants an extra Normal Summon.
allow.Giant Rex: Level 4 EARTH Dinosaur (2000 ATK) that Special Summons itself when banished by Miscellaneousaurus, Double Evolution Pill, or Ultimate Conductor Tyranno for an instant Rank 4 Evolzar Xyz.
allow.Terraforming: Limited to 1 in TCG: searches the signature Lost World Field Spell.

main: Lost World

Signature Field Spell: weakens non-Dinosaurs by 500 ATK/DEF; summons a Jurraegg Token to the opponent's field (protecting your Dinosaurs from targeting!); and protects any Normal Monster by destroying a Dinosaur (Babycerasaurus!) from your hand or Deck instead!
Souleating Oviraptor

Core starter: searches or dumps any Dinosaur on summon, then targets the Jurraegg Token to destroy it and revive a Dinosaur—letting Lost World protect the Token by destroying Babycerasaurus from your Deck instead!
Miscellaneousaurus

Limited to 1 in TCG: discards itself to make all Dinosaur monsters you control unaffected by activated effects, then banishes itself + Dinosaurs from GY to summon Animadorned Archosaur or Babycerasaurus from the Deck.
Babycerasaurus
Mandatory trigger when destroyed by a card effect (including directly inside your Deck by Lost World's substitution!): Special Summons any Level 4 or lower Dinosaur from your Deck!
Petiteranodon
Mandatory trigger when destroyed by a card effect (including inside your Deck by Lost World!): Special Summons any Level 4 or higher Dinosaur from your Deck.
Animadorned Archosaur
Level 1 Dinosaur summoned by Miscellaneousaurus: destroys 1 Dinosaur in your hand or field on summon to search Double Evolution Pill.
Ultimate Conductor Tyranno

Signature Level 10 Dinosaur boss (3500 ATK): banishes 2 Dinosaurs from GY to Special Summon itself; flips all opponent's monsters face-down as a Quick Effect; and attacks all opposing monsters while sending Defense monsters to GY for 1000 burn!
Giant Rex
Level 4 Dinosaur (2000 ATK) that Special Summons itself when banished to overlay with Oviraptor into Evolzar Laggia or Dolkka.
Scrap Raptor
Level 4 Dinosaur Tuner that destroys a Dinosaur to extend into Rank 4s.
Megalosmasher X
Level 4 2000 ATK Dinosaur Normal Monster that can be summoned by Babycerasaurus or destroyed by Survival's End.
Fossil Dig
Adds any Level 6 or lower Dinosaur from your Deck to your hand.
Double Evolution Pill
Searched by Animadorned Archosaur: banishes 1 Dinosaur and 1 non-Dinosaur from hand/GY to Special Summon Ultimate Conductor Tyranno directly from hand/Deck.
Terraforming
Limited to 1 in TCG: searches Lost World.
Survival's End
Normal Trap: destroys Normal Monsters on field (including the opponent's Jurraegg Token!) to summon Dinosaurs from Deck, and banishes from GY to pop a Dinosaur you control and an opponent's card!
extra: Rank 6 Dragon Xyz that detaches 1 material to negate any face-up card your opponent controls.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters): detaches 2 materials to negate any Summon or Spell/Trap activation and destroy it.
Rank 4 Dragon Xyz (2 Level 4 Dinosaur monsters): detaches 1 material up to twice per turn to negate any monster effect activation and destroy it.
Link-2 monster that grants piercing battle damage to Ultimate Conductor Tyranno pointed to by it.
